title: Susan Kare explains Macintosh UI ergonomics on the Computer Chronicles (1984)
summary: A 1984 Computer Chronicles segment in which Susan Kare explains the ergonomics and interface design of the original Macintosh. She introduces the interface step by step for newcomers.
why: Praised as a lesson in explaining technology to non-technical people and as a window into early Mac design.

quote.text: I think some of us (me included) would do well to keep this video in mind when explaining technology to non-technical people.
